files.hooks/collect/workflow-of.ts:
import { statusOf, type TraceNode } from '../model'
import type { Row } from './rows.js'

type Progress = {
  type?: string
  index?: number
  title?: string
  label?: string
  phaseIndex?: number
  agentId?: string
  model?: string
  state?: string
  startedAt?: number
  lastToolName?: string
  promptPreview?: string
}

const text = (value: unknown) => typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined
const number = (value: unknown) => typeof value === 'number' ? value : undefined

export function workflowOf(input: { json: Row; parentId: string; now: number }): TraceNode[] {
  const { json, parentId } = input
  const runId = text(json.runId) ?? 'workflow'
  const progress = (Array.isArray(json.workflowProgress) ? json.workflowProgress : []) as Progress[]
  const agents = progress.filter(item => item.type === 'workflow_agent' && item.agentId)
  const phaseCount = Array.isArray(json.phases) ? json.phases.length : progress.filter(item => item.type === 'workflow_phase').length
  const phasesDone = new Set<number>()
  for (const phase of new Set(agents.map(agent => agent.phaseIndex ?? 0))) {
    const inPhase = agents.filter(agent => (agent.phaseIndex ?? 0) === phase)
    if (inPhase.length > 0 && inPhase.every(agent => statusOf(agent.state) === 'done')) phasesDone.add(phase)
  }
  const startedAt = number(json.startTime)
  const duration = number(json.durationMs)
  const status = statusOf(text(json.status)) ?? 'running'

  const flow: TraceNode = {
    id: runId,
    kind: 'workflow',
    label: text(json.workflowName) ?? runId,
    parentId,
    depth: 1,
    status,
    rawStatus: text(json.status),
    model: text(json.defaultModel),
    tokens: number(json.totalTokens),
    toolCalls: [],
    startedAt,
    endedAt: status !== 'running' && startedAt !== undefined && duration ? startedAt + duration : undefined,
    phase: { done: phasesDone.size, total: phaseCount },
  }

  const children = agents.map((agent): TraceNode => {
    const agentStatus = statusOf(agent.state) ?? 'running'
    return {
      id: agent.agentId ?? `${runId}:${agent.index}`,
      kind: 'workflowAgent',
      label: agent.label ?? agent.agentId ?? '?',
      parentId: runId,
      depth: 2,
      status: agentStatus,
      rawStatus: agent.state,
      model: agent.model,
      runMode: 'background',
      nowTool: agentStatus === 'running' ? agent.lastToolName : undefined,
      prompt: agent.promptPreview,
      toolCalls: [],
      startedAt: agent.startedAt,
    }
  })

  return [flow, ...children]
}

files.hooks/model/types.ts:
export type NodeKind = 'session' | 'subagent' | 'teammate' | 'team' | 'workflow' | 'workflowAgent' | 'shell'
export type Status = 'running' | 'idle' | 'done' | 'failed' | 'stopped'
export type FileOp = 'read' | 'edit' | 'write'

export type ToolCall = {
  id: string
  name: string
  summary: string
  ok?: boolean
  at?: number
  filePath?: string
}

export type SentTo = { to: string; count: number }

export type TraceNode = {
  id: string
  kind: NodeKind
  label: string
  name?: string
  parentId?: string
  depth: number
  status: Status
  rawStatus?: string
  agentType?: string
  model?: string
  runMode?: 'background' | 'foreground'
  tokens?: number
  contextTokens?: number
  nowTool?: string
  prompt?: string
  toolCalls: ToolCall[]
  startedAt?: number
  endedAt?: number
  transcriptPath?: string
  toolUseId?: string
  phase?: { done: number; total: number }
  sentTo?: SentTo[]
  note?: 'too-large'
  stopNote?: StopNote
}

export type StopNote = { text: string; isError: boolean }

export type FileAccess = { path: string; nodeId: string; op: FileOp; at?: number }

export type TraceModel = { rootId: string; nodes: TraceNode[]; files: FileAccess[] }

import type { Messages } from './types.js'

function counted(count: number, one: string, many: string): string {
  return `${count} ${count === 1 ? one : many}`
}

export const en = {
  commandDescription: 'Open or close the parallel agent flow panel',
  panelShown: 'Opened the agent trace panel',
  panelHidden: 'Closed the agent trace panel',
  backToFlow: 'Going back from the details to the flow',
  summary: (agents, running, idle, failed) => `${counted(agents, 'agent', 'agents')} · ${running} running · ${idle} idle · ${failed} failed`,
  tabFlow: 'Flow',
  tabFiles: 'Files',
  densityCompact: 'Compact',
  densityNormal: 'Normal',
  status: { running: 'running', idle: 'idle', done: 'done', failed: 'failed', stopped: 'stopped' },
  context: tokens => `context ${tokens}`,
  tooLarge: 'transcript too large, summary only',
  backgroundJobs: count => counted(count, 'background job', 'background jobs'),
  shell: 'shell',
  engineValue: raw => ` (engine value: ${raw})`,
  phaseSteps: (done, total) => `${done}/${total} ${total === 1 ? 'step' : 'steps'}`,
  teammate: 'teammate',
  background: 'background',
  foreground: 'foreground',
  fieldKind: 'Type',
  fieldModel: 'Model',
  fieldParent: 'Parent',
  fieldSent: 'Sent',
  fieldNow: 'Now',
  missingNode: '(node gone)',
  stopAgent: 'Stop agent',
  copyPath: 'Copy transcript path',
  pathCopied: 'Transcript path copied',
  stopFailed: 'Stop failed',
  stopped: 'Stopped',
  promptTitle: 'Prompt',
  collapse: 'Collapse',
  expand: rows => `Show all (${counted(rows, 'row', 'rows')})`,
  members: count => counted(count, 'member', 'members'),
  toolCalls: count => counted(count, 'tool call', 'tool calls'),
  more: count => `… ${count} more`,
  conflict: 'Possible conflict',
  fileCounts: (reads, edits, writes) => `${counted(reads, 'read', 'reads')} · ${counted(edits, 'edit', 'edits')} · ${counted(writes, 'write', 'writes')}`,
  bashNotTracked: 'Files changed through Bash are not listed',
} satisfies Messages
